title: AI Music Marketer Full-Stack Rewrite

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace contains an existing FastAPI music-marketing app and three supplied v2 documents defining a revised full-stack product and API:
bullets: Current layout uses a Python/FastAPI backend and a vanilla JavaScript/CSS frontend, with SQLAlchemy/SQLite, a background pipeline, five agent modules, and tests.
The implementation prompts specify Next.js/React/TypeScript/Tailwind, FastAPI, PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy/Alembic, private media storage, and a first song-upload-to-A&R-report vertical slice.

The API document specifies /api/v1 endpoints and an upload → analysis job → Song Intelligence → A&R report workflow; it also prohibits unapproved publishing, distribution, spending, and training on music without rights and consent.

proposed_outcome: Rebuild the existing app to the supplied v2 product, implementation, and API specifications, with a complete updated project structure and a tested first vertical slice. Preserve the stated privacy, rights, uncertainty-labeling, and human-approval safeguards, and do not perform deployment or consequential external actions.
